summary.ru: Великое княжество Владимирское — государственное образование, русское княжество XII—XIV веков, ставшее ядром Русского государства.
summary.en: The Grand Principality of Vladimir, before 1157 the Principality of Suzdal, commonly known as Vladimir-Suzdal, or simply Suzdalia, was a Russian principality. Its capital was the city of Vladimir. In Russian historiography, its original territory is commonly denoted as northeast Russia or northeast Rus'.
